count_definition: PREREG Sec 2.6, in its own words. E1j/E2j: 'a Q027 Sec 2.5 contributing night (>=30 eligible rows, defined d*_t, matured, non-excluded) that additionally carries >=30 eligible rows with a non-null subscore_j and non-zero within-night variance in it; for E2j, additionally every one of the night's retained layers non-null on those rows.' E3j: 'a Q027 Sec 2.5 contributing night that additionally (i) passes Sec 2.4's Gate-0 night rule, (ii) has |S^prod_t| >= 1, and (iii) has >=10 distinct same-night candidates in that night's Sec 3 B4 distance-matched control pool ... for every pick in S^prod_t union S^abl_t,j. Ten is the number B4 actually draws ... A night failing (iii) is non-contributing and counted, never back-filled.' Maturity: 'Binding maturity: 20 sessions, uniform across every eligible row' (Sec 5.1). 'Every contributing night here is post-lock by construction' (Sec 5.1) since the window opens 2026-09-15, the session after the lock commit.
